title: O.A./53/2014 — DILIP SHIVPURI v. M/O FINANCE
text:

Principal Bench, New Delhi
OA No. 53/2014
This the 1st day of September, 2015
Hon’ble Shri Sudhir Kumar, Member (A)

New Moti Bagh, New Delhi.

(By Advocate: Sh. Rajesh Katyal for R-1 to R-3)

(OA No. 53/2014)
(2)
Order (oral)
Per Sudhir Kumar, Member (A)
Learned counsel for the applicant fairly submits that this case has
since become infructuous, since the applicant has superannuated, and
Private Respondent Nos.R-4 and R-5 have also superannuated, and only
R-6 is still serving, but, as prayed for by him, the applicant does not wish
to pursue this case. The O.A. is, therefore, dismissed as withdrawn, on
the ground of it having become infructuous.
(Raj Vir Sharma) (Sudhir Kumar)
Member (J) Member (A)
/kdr/
